# TipTop Food Tech

> TipTop Food Tech is a popcorn manufacturer based in Delhi, India, operating since 1991. It supplies bulk and private-label popcorn to institutional buyers (IRCTC, Northern Railway, NAFED, HAFED, Kendriya Bhandar, Central Police Canteen) and works as an OEM manufacturing partner for snack brands including Haldiram, Bikanervala, Bikaji, Yellow Diamond, 24 Seven, and Babaji.

## Company facts
- Founded: 1991 (35+ years of manufacturing experience)
- Location: Bawana Industrial Area, DSIIDC, Delhi – 110039, India
- Manufacturing units: 2
- Product varieties: 25+
- Customers served: 1M+
- Certifications: FSSAI registered, ISO and HACCP standards
- Process: air-popped (not deep fried), naturally gluten-free
- Contact: +91 98106 37185, info@tiptopfoodtech.com

## Products
- Crispy Crunchy – butter flavour, bestseller
- Mera PopCorn – classic salted, air-popped
- Tip Top Popcorn – salted, homely taste
- Pop Corn (Classic & Butter) – export-quality packs
- Custom flavours on request: cheese, caramel, masala

## Services
- Bulk supply for retailers, cinemas, canteens, and institutional buyers
- Private label manufacturing (flavour formulation, packaging, production)
- Export-ready packing to international hygiene and packaging standards
- Custom flavour development
